scientific_limitations: The phase theorem is a bulk joint-dimension asymptotic and does not claim an exact finite-size aspect-ratio cutoff.
Endpoint corank scales with c/m tending to zero or one are outside the stated asymptotic regime.
The exact finite neighboring-rank identity is valid for all interior ranks of generic rectangular complex determinantal varieties.
An unindexed source could in principle contain the same aspect-ratio phase statement.
title: A sharp aspect-ratio threshold for bulk curvature of rectangular determinantal degrees
